TREND_CAPTURE_ENTRY path added with separate conditions, scoring, and anti-FOMO protection. Same safety pipeline maintained. Ready for backtest integration and TESTNET activation (requires explicit user approval after all 10 success criteria met).

Regime filter: SAME — still active in both paths; trend capture adds more conditions but same regime filter
